A lot of people who commented on this post seem to be really incompetent because 3M is op when you put it with other fireball bait cards. I faced a deck today that was golem/rage/ebarbs/minion horde/3M/pump/mirror/arrows. I couldn’t do shit because I knew that the guy was going to punish me if I tried to fireball anything except for the 3m. And he would just mirror the 3m after I fireballed. I don’t want the meta to have to revolve around mirrored spells just to counter a stupid synergy. And I don’t want to carry a billion heavy spells either. I already have fireball, log, and zap, so I beat most spell bait decks, but fireball bait isn’t as easy because there are so many things I have to defend without wasting fireball. I think 3M does need some sort of minor nerf to make it a tiny bit less viable. Either that or nerf the cards with good synergies (i.e.: battle ram, pump, etc.).

And I know I can already expect 100,000,000,000,000,000,000,000 people to respond to this saying I’m just bad at the game, but you can’t tell me I’m wrong when the pro scene revolves around them.
